paragraphs: Ada bar Hana — Berakhot, chapter 5, halakhah 3.

notes.text: These are two separate name-and-reference attestations.

The actual Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:3 paragraph has Ada bar bar Chana (אדא בר בר חנה), while Hyman supplies Ada bar Chana. The William Davidson Eruvin 68b paragraph explicitly has Rav Acha bar Chana. The extra bar and final-letter difference are preserved in the comparison rather than repaired in Hyman; the two attestations do not establish one father or identity.
